latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of flight-price-chart skill.

- Embed interactive 60-day flight price trend charts in AI-generated responses.
- Requires SerpAPI key to fetch real-time flight price data; provides setup instructions and fallback to simulated data for development.
- Offers buy/wait recommendations and price analysis (min, max, average, current price, trend).
- Integrates with flight search results, works with flyai, and supports visual, interactive charts with contextual stats.
- Includes confidence levels in responses based on available data.
- Features customizable chart color coding and visual design for clarity.
